title: One Crate, One Invoice
description: SwiftCargo bills one invoice per shipment, no exceptions. Confirm asking for an invoice on the same shipment twice hands back the original rather than minting a duplicate.
successCondition: Book a shipment, then POST /api/billing/shipments/:shipmentId/invoice twice in a row with the same currency. Both calls return 201 with an invoice object, and both responses have the identical invoice id and createdAt — the second call did not create a new row.
hints: The endpoint always responds 201 even on the second, idempotent call — check the id field to prove it's the same invoice, not the status code alone.
Book the shipment first via POST /api/booking to get a real shipmentId to invoice against.
